connection_condition: every school record carries the name of the district that administers it, and the school portion of the CDS code identifies its position within that district
description: A district is composed of the schools it administers; a school site belongs to exactly one district and has no meaning without it.

connection_condition: districts are identified within a county through the county portion of the CDS code and the county name carried on each school record
description: A county is composed of the school districts located within it; county-level totals are obtained by aggregating the districts and schools it contains.

connection_condition: the school type code classifies the school site itself
description: Every school site belongs to exactly one school operation category, so each category is a subtype of School; district and agency records have no school category.

connection_condition: the district type code classifies districts and agencies
description: A district is an instance of exactly one district operation category, such as Unified School District or Elementary School District.

connection_condition: the educational option code is assigned to the school site
description: A school's educational option code identifies which operating model it is an instance of, for example a Continuation School or a State Special School.

connection_condition: the virtual status is assigned to the school site
description: A school is an instance of one virtual delivery category, from not virtual through exclusively virtual.

connection_condition: the charter indicator is assigned to the school site
description: A charter school is a particular kind of school; charter schools form a subset of all schools.

connection_condition: the magnet indicator is recorded on the school record
description: A magnet program is a programme component offered by a school; a school that offers one is composed of that programme, and the programme cannot exist without the school.

connection_condition: the provision status is recorded on the school's meal-reporting record
description: The meal-provision arrangement is a component of how a school operates its meal service and is meaningful only in the context of that school.

connection_condition: street, city, state and zip values are recorded on the school record
description: A school's address is a component of its identity and contact information; an address record has no meaning independently of the school it locates.

connection_condition: latitude and longitude are recorded on the school record
description: The geographic coordinates are a component of the school's location identity used for spatial selection.

connection_condition: up to three administrator slots are recorded on the school record
description: Administrators are people attached to a school; each administrator slot is a component of the school record and is meaningless without the school it belongs to.

connection_condition: the e-mail address is stored in the same numbered slot as the administrator's first and last name
description: An administrator's e-mail address is a component of that administrator's contact details and is only interpretable together with the matching name slot.

connection_condition: school-level SAT rows carry a CDS code that matches the school's CDS code
description: A school's SAT results are a component of its reported performance; school-level SAT rows exist only in relation to the school that produced them.

connection_condition: district-level SAT rows carry the district CDS code whose school portion is 0000000
description: The same SAT table also holds district-wide aggregates, so SAT performance can legitimately be measured at district level; a district aggregate must not be mistaken for one of its schools.

connection_condition: the low and high grade values on the meal record describe the same school's grade range that the grade span column states as a range
description: The grade span offered on the school record and the low/high grade pair on the meal record express the same underlying concept of which grades a school covers, using two different encodings.

connection_condition: both columns are recorded on the school record but encode different ranges of grades
description: The grades a school is authorised to offer and the grades it actually serves are closely related but not identical; they differ for a substantial minority of schools.

connection_condition: the free meal count is the numerator and K-12 enrolment the denominator of the same school's rate
description: The eligible free rate is derived by dividing a school's free-meal-eligible K-12 count by its K-12 enrolment.

connection_condition: the FRPM count is the numerator and K-12 enrolment the denominator of the same school's rate
description: The eligible FRPM rate is derived by dividing a school's free-or-reduced-price-meal-eligible K-12 count by its K-12 enrolment.

connection_condition: NumGE1500 is the numerator and NumTstTakr the denominator within the same SAT record
description: The excellence rate is derived by dividing the number of test takers scoring 1500 or above by the total number of test takers at the same reporting level.

connection_condition: both counts are recorded on the same meal-reporting row but over different populations
description: K-12 grade-basis enrolment and ages 5-17 enrolment are two related but distinct measures of school size; the correct measure depends on whether a question is phrased by grade or by age.

connection_condition: both counts are recorded on the same meal-reporting row over different populations
description: Free-meal-eligible counts are reported on both a grade basis and an age basis and the two differ; the basis must match the phrasing of the question.

connection_condition: both counts are recorded on the same meal-reporting row, the FRPM count including reduced-price-eligible students
description: Free-meal eligibility and free-or-reduced-price eligibility are related measures of meal need; the FRPM count is the broader population, so the two are not interchangeable.

connection_condition: the open date is recorded on the school record
description: A school is associated with the date it opened; opening-period analysis depends on that date being a genuine observation rather than a default value.

connection_condition: the status is recorded on the school record and the closed date is populated only for closed schools
description: A school carries an operating status that determines whether it is currently in scope for analysis.

connection_condition: the academic year label is carried on the same meal-reporting row as the enrolment and meal counts
description: Enrolment and meal-eligibility facts are scoped to a single reported academic year, so they cannot be compared across years.
